name: A Motley Bind
source:
As court jester, Isa is tasked with helping the princess cheer up before her coronation. A tall order, considering that Her Highness laughs only at her pain.

[From [url=https://howleki.itch.io/a-motley-bind]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
作为宫廷小丑，伊莎的任务是在公主加冕前帮助她振作起来。考虑到殿下只对她的痛苦发笑，这是一项艰巨的任务。

[来自[url=https://howleki.itch.io/a-motley-bind]itch.io[/url]]
